notes: REF-BM-02: metadata is simulated from a hardcoded map/URL string (no real page fetch); fills title/description/tags only, no favicon or preview image. REF-BM-04: edits url/title/description/tags/collection but there is no note field. REF-BM-06: add always creates a new item with a fresh id; no duplicate-url detection or convergence to editing. REF-BM-14: no #tag syntax handling; query is plain substring match. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact match. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read-later flag, view, or toggle. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-23: no markdown note field or rendering. REF-BM-24/25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive support. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archived flag or archive action; Archive nav always returns empty; only delete works. REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved filters. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export. REF-BM-32: Settings button is inert; sort/view are transient UI state, no persisted default sort, items-per-page, or font-size settings.
